 Here are the Cricket Predictions for the Women's Big Bash League 2026 - 6th Match - Sydney Thunder Women vs Brisbane Heat Women and 7th Match - Sydney Sixers Women vs Hobart Hurricanes Women, to be played on the 1st of November at the Drummoyne Oval, Sydney.
 Match Prediction - Sydney Thunder Women v Brisbane Heat Women 
 6th Match - Sydney Thunder Women vs Brisbane Heat Women (Drummoyne Oval, Sydney) 
 Ground Stat:
 Average 1st Innings Total at Drummoyne Oval, Sydney (Women's Big Bash League) - 128 
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Drummoyne Oval, Sydney (Women's Big Bash League) - 119 
 Current Form Brisbane Heat Women:
 Brisbane Heat Women are currently placed at the 6th position on points table with 1 loss to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is -0.150. 
 The top run scorer for Brisbane Heat Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Redmayne with 58 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Brisbane Heat Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Sianna Ginger with 2 scalps under her belt. 
 Brisbane Heat Women have lost their previous match against Sydney Sixers Women by 4 wickets.
 Brisbane Heat Women batted first and they posted a total of 154 for 5 in 20 overs. Grace Harris got out cheaply. After her dismissal, Charli Knott and Georgia Redmayne revived the innings with a stand of 97 runs for the 2nd wicket partnership. Knott made 57 while Redmayne scorer 58 runs in only 44 deliveries, hitting 8 boundaries. The middle order however disappointed and kept losing wickets in regular succession without giving any impetus to the innings. As a result, Brisbane Heat Women had to settle for a total of 154, even though at one point, they were aiming at 165+.
 During the chase, Ellyse Perry and Sophia Dunkley gave Sydney Sixers Women a dream start. They collected 53 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Dunkley made 37 runs while Perry scored 58 runs in only 38 deliveries, collecting 7 fours and 1 six. Amelia Kerr also contributed healthily but got out after getting a start. Alice Capsey then took over and batted with a lot of calculation. She stayed not out at 21 and got Sydney Sixers Women over the line on the last ball of the match with 4 wickets in hand.
 Current Form Sydney Thunder Women:
 Sydney Thunder Women are currently placed at the 1st position on points table with 1 win to their credit. They have 2 points to their name. Their NRR is 1.335. 
 The top run scorer for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Anika Learoyd with 48 runs to her name. 
 The top wicket taker for Sydney Thunder Women in the Women's Big Bash League 2026 is Georgia Voll with 4 scalps under her belt. 
 Sydney Thunder Women have lost their previous match against Melbourne Renegades Women by 6 wickets.
 Melbourne Renegades Women batted first and they posted a total of 138 for 9 in 20 overs. Courtney Webb and Hayley Matthews gave a stable but very slow start to Melbourne Renegades Women. Matthews made 45 runs before being dismissed by Hannah Darlington. Georgia Voll rolled her fingers over the ball and she made life of Melbourne Renegades Women quite difficult. She picked up 4 wickets for only 26 runs and Melbourne Renegades Women were eventually restricted to an under par total of 138 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sydney Thunder Women started off well with Georgia Voll and Phoebe Litchfield stitching a partnership of 34 runs for the 1st wicket. After these two got out, Anika Learoyd and Heather Knight took the responsibility of taking Sydney Thunder Women over the line. Anika Learoyd scored 48 runs in 37 balls while Knight made 29 runs, stayed not out and helped Thunder Women get over the line in the 17th over itself with 6 wickets in hand.

Annabel Sutherland removed Rachel Trenaman in the 9th over and Hobart Hurricanes Women slowed down after that. Nicola Carey made 32 runs but she consumed 25 deliveries for doing so and it didn't help the team much.
